Rule.name: LDAP ApacheDS - Provision Account
Rule.Description:
Creates an LDAP ApacheDS account for one identity, using the application's Create Account policy. Skips the identity if its Status is not Active or it already has an LDAP account. Returns a one-line result.
Input: identityName (e.g. "1005"). Called by the "HR Lifecycle - Status Change Notification" workflow and by the rule "LDAP ApacheDS - Provision Active Users".
